name: whatsapp-bot-spg
description: WhatsApp Bot untuk monitoring SPG/SPB dengan fitur absensi dan registrasi customer

scripts.test: for f in index.js src/app.js src/config/*.js src/utils/*.js src/services/*.js src/handlers/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo '✅ Syntax OK'
scripts.verify: node -e "require('./src/config'); require('./src/utils/helpers'); require('./src/services/storageService'); require('./src/handlers/commandHandler'); require('./src/app'); console.log('✅ All modules verified');"
